messages.subject: Unable to deploy shiny app
parts:

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Unable to deploy shiny app
parts:
From your logs, it appears the app is having trouble running locally, is that the case? If so, please ask for general Shiny help on the Community site.
Or are you having trouble deploying it to shinyapps.io, in which case, please provide the logs of the deploy.
Or you have successfully deployed it to shinyapps.io, and the app is having trouble running? In which case, please provide the application id or URL.
